title: Inzwi Mujecha Rekare
intro: Pakati pevatumwa vekutanga vaAllah, paiva nemumwe ane zita rake rinopenya kwenguva pfupi asi rine zvarinoreva muKorani. Munhu uyu akararama kare kare vaprofita vakuru vasati vatumwa, uye aizivikanwa nekutaura chokwadi uye mwoyo murefu usingazununguki. Nyaya yavo ipfupi asi nhaka yavo inogara munhoroondo isingaperi. Ndiani mweya uyu wakanaka?
clues: Ndiri mumwe wevatumwa vekutanga, vakataurwa muchidimbu asi zvine musoro muKorani.
Hunhu hwangu hwakaratidzwa nekuzvipira kuchokwadi kusingazununguki.
Ndinorangarirwa mubhuku raAllah pakati peavo vaive vakashinga uye vane mwoyo murefu.
Ndima pfupi shoma dziri muQuran dzinotsanangura nyaya yangu.
Allah vakandikudza nenzira yangu yakasiyana, isina kugoverwa nevamwe vaprofita.
Ndakakwidziridzwa pachinzvimbo chepamusoro, kukudzwa kunoshamisa muQuran.

verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
